ticks.note: Tick 1 enters A, so its entry action runs: entries = 1, x = 0.
The self-loop leaves A and enters it again: its effect runs (x = 1) and then A's entry action runs again (entries = 2).
Exit and re-entry again: x = 2, entries = 3.
x = 3, entries = 4: every self-loop is a full exit and re-entry.
